response_content: Do not leave your pets here, seriously. I came here to drop off a stray cat I had rescued to get fixed since they quoted us the best price and it was obviously for a reason. Upon arriving at 7 AM, I couldn't locate the front door but instead happened upon the unlocked door to the kennel and boarding area where people were paying to have their pets boarded. When I finally found the front door (which is in the back of the building), the girl in the front had no idea the kennel door was unlocked and panicked because someone could've been in the building when she got there alone in the morning. Which also means that anyone could've waltzed in and taken all of the animals that were being boarded. Anyway, we figured it was a freak thing and we had taken time to trap the kitten so we kept our appointment and everything went smoothly. She was boarded for 3 nights (this wasn't our cat and we have 2 other at home so while she was helping we thought it best to pay a little extra to get a little help and give her some extra care). We brought her home and she was literally ravenous as though she had barely eaten the entire time she had been there, a stitch had already fallen out, and her collar was so loose her feet kept getting caught in it. We bring her back to have the stitches removed 2 weeks later and wait over an hour before asking where the cat is. The girl up front said she would check, forgot, and came back 10 minutes later with the cat. We were told she was fine and wouldn't need any future visits. After the cat hid under the bed for 5 hours, she finally emerged to eat and I noticed THE STITCHES WERE NEVER REMOVED. We paid full price to have the cat taken care of and to their knowledge she was our cat that we had purchased or adopted and that's the treatment we received. If you care about your animals even a little, go somewhere else. This feels like a sketchy state medical clinic for animals, we never even met a veterinarian and the dogs on view in the boarding area were fighting and biting each other trying to lay on the one dog bed the four of them had to share while the staff did nothing.

Yelp has never failed me. I should have known. We just moved to the area and I was willing to give this place a try because it was close by, despite the low star rating. I made an appointment online for my dog to receive her yearly vaccinations. The next day my wife called to confirm the appointment. 1 hour before the appointment I called to confirm (just being thorough). When they answered the phone they insisted that I did not have an appointment,...even though I had received a confirmation email. The woman then stated that they would not see my dog because we were new to the area and they had not seen her before. What?!
I called back for clarification and she then explained that it was the law that my dog needed an exam before they could administer vaccinations. This seemed logical to me, although I had never heard it from my previous 2 vets in other cities where I've lived. Then she hung up the phone without even trying to persuade me to schedule an appointment for an exam! 
If they are trying to keep ppl away...they are doing a great job! Poor customer service. No courtesy. Zero professionalism. I mean...come on...I'm calling you to give you my money! How much easier does it get?!
If this is the service before you get to the vet...I can only imagine the service they provide once you are in their fine establishment! 
Going to one of the other 10 vets in the area with 4+ star reviews.
Jorge is awsome!! Jorge is very patient, you don't find to many people that shares and acknowledges their time with the pet owner.

I had been warned of this place before, but it was close to where I live and it was the only place I knew that could treat birds (I'm new to the area), so I tried to bring my pet cockatiel here for care when I noticed her acting sick and just not herself.

I don't think the world revolves around me, and I don't think anyone else's pet is any less precious than my own.  Here's the thing about birds, though: when one of them starts looking visibly sick, the clock starts ticking.  They die fast--I have kept birds for almost 20 years; I've seen it happen.  You have 24-48 hours MAX to get them treatment.  I called ahead, they told me I could just walk in.  Ok.  I walk in early afternoon.  The front desk staff says their vet who treats birds isn't in right now, but they can make me an appointment for the following morning.  Ok; there might have just been some confusion with the desk staff and scheduling with the vet who treats avian and exotic patients.  My bird is having some problems, but I don't think they're severe yet, so I agree to come back 9 AM the next day and keep an eye on her at home that night.  When I show up for this appointment, they take me and my bird into an exam room--only to tell me that the vet isn't in.  Umm, I set an appointment; what the hell do you mean he's not in?  They tell me he'll be back in at 1:00, and I can leave my bird there in the meantime.  

I come back at 1:00, and this is the part that royally pissed me off.  "You here for the bird?" the blonde lady with bad skin asked me.  "Yeah," I said.  She says, "I'll go see if Dr. [Too-Busy-to-Care-Incompetent-Idiot, DVM] treated it."

"It."  IT.  

"It" is what I call the seagull picking through the dumpster behind Walmart.  "It" is what I call the brown spider I that crushed in my bedroom.  My bird may technically be a lower life form than you, lady, but she is NOT an "it."  SHE is my cherished pet, my little feathered buddy since I was a kid.  The front desk worker brought back the carrier and told me that the veterinarian had been too busy to treat my bird.  "If you want, we can set you an appointment for tomorrow morning," the fat one said.  "We usually aren't too busy on Saturday mornings."

By now I felt deeply and personally offended.  Here I am, a client seeking their services, who's willing to pay for those services, and they treat me like I'm imposing on their time; and this sick little animal I've brought to them, in need of care and attention, is just an "it".  All this time I had done nothing that might be construed as rude, and said nothing worse to them than, "if there are any more delays I'm going to have to take her somewhere else."  I glared at them now, with the most contemptuous b*tchface I could summon, as I agreed to a 9:30 AM appointment the following day, and then I grabbed the bird carrier and got the hell out of there.

As soon as my bird and I were in the car, I called another veterinary office that I found on Google while I had been waiting that morning and got an appointment that same day.  The service at this other place was WAY more satisfactory, and I plan to write a positive review on this other place once the follow-up I have with them is completed.  As for Tri City, I did not go back.  They cost me those precious first 24 hours, and if this had been a more serious problem like an egg-bind or prolapse, my bird would be dead.  I didn't even bother cancelling the appointment with them; they had wasted so much of my time, I thought I might waste some of theirs.  Sadly though, they might not even have noticed or cared that I didn't show up this morning.  And even if I had, who's to say they wouldn't have been too busy to see my bird?  They sure as hell better not bill me for a no-show, or else I'm going to send them an invoice for all of my time that they wasted, and tack on an extra fee for my bird's pain and suffering; I'm feeling generous, though, so I'll waive the charge for that front desk worker calling my pet an "it."  Also, the waiting room stinks of dog pee and there's cat and dog hair on the seats in the exam room.  Gross!

Disorganization, lack of training, lack of attention to detail and poor communication within the facility. They need to hire a consultant to fix the entire facility and it's processes.

The experience from beginning to end was horrible.  We brought our puppy in as an emergency for a broken leg and waited almost an hour to be seen by a doctor.  We told the doctor that she might possibly have a broken leg and he still kept moving her leg around.  Our puppy was screaming in pain.  We had X-rays done which took another 45min.  The doctor showed us her X-rays and told us that she had a fracture on her radius and ulna.  He gave us two suggestions for the treatment, splint or surgery.  We asked for his recommendation and he suggested splint.  We agreed to it and he had the nurse take her back to get it done.  They told us it would take about 2 hours and they would call us when she is ready to be picked up.  When she came out her whole left leg was bandaged up. The nurse that was holding her told us that she wouldn't walk so he had to carry her out.  Of course she couldn't walk.. she had a broken leg!!  They didn't give us the pain medication until we asked which took another 20min of waiting.  The take home care instructions contradicted each other.  On one page it would say she needs to come back every 1-2 days to get re-bandaged.  Another page says every 2 weeks. Also the nurse didn't even bother to schedule her for her next check up.  The next day after getting the splint done we noticed redness under her armpit and it looked like she was bleeding from inside the bandage.  We rushed her to emergency care at Sage.  The doctor at Sage looked at her splint and told us that it was done incorrectly.  The plastic for the splint was not arranged correctly and they did not put enough padding to prevent the splint from scratching against her skin.  Also the splint was put on too tight.  The doctor showed us the pictures of what her leg looked like after they took the splint off and it was super bruised up.  The doctor at Sage had to redo the splint.  Our puppy feels so much better now and the redness is going away.

Tri City caused us such a stressful experience.  The doctor and nurses don't know what they are doing and they don't seem to care for the wellbeing of your pets.  I would not recommend this place to anyone.  Please please take your pets elsewhere for better care.  I would not want anyone to go through the same horrific experience.

I have been an avid Yelp user since the very beginning, but this is the first time I've ever felt compelled to actually create an account and write a review.  In summary, this is a business where the customer is treated as an adversary.

A Valpak flyer from Tri City Vet featured the following coupon:  "VACCINATION CLINIC ALL DAY TUESDAY AND THURSDAY -FREE- NO OFFICE VISIT FEE WITH VACCINATIONS FOR HEALTHY PETS WITH NO HEALTH PROBLEMS. NO BIOHAZARD OR OTHER HIDDEN FEES WITH VACCINES. COUPON MAY NOT BE COMBINED WITH ANY OTHER OFFER. OFFER EXPIRES 3/31/17"  

My dog is due for her rabies booster and in spite of Tri City's lackluster Yelp reviews, I thought, "How bad could it be for a simple vaccine clinic?"  The advertised price for a rabies shot was $11.00

When I arrived there were two women working behind the counter. One whom I'll call "Flustered", was working at the check-out counter and the other one, "Rude", was working next to the Registration counter.  I stood patiently at the registration counter in front of Rude for an extended period of time during which I was completely ignored. Not a "Hello", not a "Just a minute", not a "Please have a seat and I'll be with you in a bit." Absolutely nothing.  Eventually Rude got up and just walked away, still without acknowledging that I was there.  I was just about to leave when Flustered noticed me standing there and asked if I needed help. I explained that I was here for the shot clinic in the ad. Flustered told me to fill out the new customer form which I did promptly and then stood there a while longer until I was curtly told to sit down and wait.  I've already been there about 15 minutes at this point. 

Flustered's customers were growing increasingly agitated at the level of service. Rude returned and began having some abrupt conversation with Flustered's customers.  A new customer came in and waited at the registration counter the same way I did. Rude bellowed something at him after he was standing there for 5 minutes or so and he grabbed a seat next to me. 7-10 minutes later Flustered pointed at me and said "I can help you now."  When I got to the counter she told me to sit back down because she was,  "still  helping another customer who, has been here for an hour trying to pick up his dog." 
 
A frail looking old woman came in because there was some problem with her bill. All I could hear was Rude's side of the conversation:
"No that is just someone else's invoice stapled to your bill. You can just ignore that." 
"It doesn't matter that isn't yours, you were charged correctly. SEE? You can just throw that other one away."
"I don't know, it was probably just sitting on the printer and someone grabbed it and stapled it to your bill." 
"Look, I'll just tear it off for you and throw it in the trash for you.", which she did and then  thrust the bill back towards the poor lady using all the body language of a parent that was ordering a child into a timeout. 

When I was finally called back up to Flustered's station she asked if I had an appointment. I showed her the coupon. "I'm just here for the vaccination clinic; I didn't think an appointment was necessary based on the ad"  Rude aggressively stepped in, "NO!  That's only free with an exam. You need to schedule an exam."  I told her that I wasn't here for the exam, just the shot clinic.  Rude more forcefully stated the need for an exam for a free vaccination. I then realized that she was referring to a completely different coupon on the flip side of the flyer:
"FREE RABIES VACCINATION WITH REGULAR PRICE EXAM. WITH COUPON ONLY. NOT VALID WITH ANY OTHER OFFER."  I again pointed out the vaccination clinic coupon, telling them "I'm here for this one, not that other one." 
 
"That's NOT how it works! It says right on it: free vaccination with an exam!" Rude said emphatically. Rude then turned to Flustered and told her in no uncertain terms, "If his dog needs shots he needs to schedule an exam first!" and then Rude turned away. 

At that point I put my hands up and backed away from the counter. "I'm done here." I said flatly. "You guys advertised a vaccination clinic today and you obviously don't have that."
Rude responded with unmistakable disdain in her voice, "Great. Good-bye!"

Was it a misunderstanding on my part? Unlikely. Instead it looks, feels and smells like deceptive bait and switch advertising -- OR -- employees that were unaware of the ad. Bad business practices either way.   If it were that issue alone, I would have grumbled about the 40 minutes or so i wasted there and moved on.  It was the behavior of the staff that pushed me to write this.  It wasn't only me being treated poorly, it was every customer I saw in that office today. If this is how they treat the customers, I hate to think how the animals are treated.

Possibly against their policy but should be praised for getting what needed to be done, done. 

As well as all of this, when you bring an animal in to be seen there are the labs needed for diagnosis as well as "extras" they list. If I could give this place zero stars I would! Absolutely TERRIBLE! Made an appointment for our 8 week old puppies for them to come in for deworming. I had my 3 kids with me and our two puppies. I had to wait in line for 20 minutes for the receptionist to get to me and to tell me the doctor left for a surgery so you're going to have to reschedule next week. Of course I was furious, since it was a act of God getting my 3 girls and two puppies there! She didn't care at all and says you for a phone call and a voicemail a little bit ago. I showed her my phone that I didn't receive either and she didn't care at all. She says well my computer says you did, so you did too bad for you. I said I can't come back another time and they need to be seen she said well there's no doctor so you can't. Not only did she not care but she immediately started helping the next people right in front of me!!!! RUDE!!

Unprofessional and left me feeling scammed.  I bought the healthy dog package that included an exam and vaccinations and they refused to honor it when I came back for the remaining shot.  I tried resolving the issue and talk to management without any success and I was made to pay twice for the service.  The conditions of the office smelled and looked very dirty. I wouldn't bring my pet back there again.  And I would not recommend this place to anyone.  It amazes me that they could care less about customer retention.
Worst customer service. Avoid this place. It takes forever for the vet to approve the medical records for insurance claim. It's months already since the procedure was done.

This vet hospital is extra ordinary and awesome!! My little puppy was sick again for the third time and I didn't have anymore extra money to bring my puppy at that time again but this hospital was extremely kind and caring enough to still take and treat my very sick puppy without a payment or downpayment! I made a payment arrangement if I can pay them in a week when my paycheck comes...and wow!! This hospital granted and accepted my payment arrangement without me begging and getting embarrassed!!! Thank you so much for all your kindness,consideration,understanding,compassion and providing great TLC to my puppy!! God bless you all!!

My Review has been deleted but I will not allow such a horrible experience go unseen this place is horrible my dog got parvo boarding there and died !!!! it is sad the way they treated him ...missing vital injections daily and did not have the proper medicine to increases chances of survival I had to drive far to other hospitals to buy certain medicines .....for them to neglect treatment anyways!!!!!!! giveing a parvo dog cold baths and left to air dry!! My dog ended up dieing of an ammonia ppl its best to take my advice then to go to this money hungrey non humanitarian place!

Very disappointed.  We have been a customer here for many many years with  different pets. Never had a problem.  I have even boarded here a few time always a good experience.  NOT THIS TIME!  I picked up my dog after a 2 week stay and my heart  was broken.  First they could not locate my dogs harness or leash ( never found it)and then they could not find my dogs blanket and toys we dropped her off with.  Once they did find the toys and blanket it was handed back to me packed up just as I handed it to them when we dropped her off.  She was NOT given her blanket or toys during her stay ( I know as it smelled of my fabric softener and not a single dog hair on it)Broke my heart she did not have any comforts from home during those two weeks.   NOT TO MENTION... I paid to have her bathed and nail trim... that did not happen either.   So disappointed!   I feel as if the management as changed  they last year or so.    Be careful using the boarding services!   The front desk gals are very sweet and friendly.

F for fail in requesting appointment online. Per receptionist, customer still need to call the place to confirm the appointment made online. Shouldnt that be their role to follow up with their sign ups online and coordinate on their end...and not the customers job?? If thats the case, then what is the functionality of requesting appointment via online for those customers?  Very disappointed about the service, and the fact that it was a holiday... the receptionist said the earliest time they can book us was at 7pm. I was forced enough to take the latest appointment where the doctor is in. Turns out they ended up rescheduling you for their own convenience;not customer centered., I would have rescheduled some other week, but due to time constraint, I couldnt. Mind you all, I signed up for a 9am appointment online because it is convenient.  It threw off all my agenda on my day off. Unacceptable. Need to train more courteous and service oriented staff not some staff who does not look approachable.

Customer service here sucks! The receptionists are not very friendly.  When you first enter they never greet you. They give you the look of "ohh great". And when you take your pets for vaccines,  they take forever to do what they are suppose to do.They take about 2 hours. When my dog gets a physical, what they tell me is what I already figured out before going to the appointment. Ridiculous! They try to persuade you into running tests on your pet just so that they suck money off of you. The only reason why I chose this place for my dogs was because they have emergency care until midnight in case of an emergency. But ill go to another vet clinic . Don't come here!!!

This veterinary hospital is only "okay" if you are going for something simple (like vaccinations). There is usually a wait, even if you have an appointment. After my recent experience, I would not come here again. Please listen to the other reviewers who say that this team does not care about your pet. I came in to have my dog checked for a suspicious lump. Dr Salwan felt her abdomen and said she could possibly have a hernia. He immediately suggested surgery. I said I wanted to be sure before any surgery was done. I asked for x-rays. He also said I should do a blood test because I was concerned she might be pregnant. They never called back with the results of the x-ray or blood test. I kept calling back multiple times. Finally, a different dr told me my dog "could have" pyometra and it was inconclusive whether or not there was a hernia. They told me over the phone that an ultrasound should be able to tell them what was going on. I made an appointment for an ultrasound, showed up a half hour early, then when it was time for the appointment, someone actually comes over and tells me the specialist did not show up with the ultrasound machine. I have no idea why no one called me beforehand. I had to go to a different veterinarian - he did a wonderful, thorough exam and said my dog did not have a hernia but was just in a stage of false pregnancy. The ultrasound was several hundred dollars cheaper than what was quoted by this hospital. What insults me even more is all the back and forth between the front desk. My appointment was from September, and they STILL have not given me the medical records I requested. (The new veterinarian was able to send them to my insurance within a few days!). I am still in the process of trying to get the records - I have been told three times that they would be emailed to me. During the last call, I was informed that they can only fax the records over. Why didn't anyone tell me this from the start?!? Today, someone finally picked up the phone (after two minutes of ringing), does NOT answer, lets me hear background noise for a minute, and then hangs up on me! I have no idea how they can hire such unprofessional people. NOBODY from this hospital ever called back to ask how my pet was - pyometra is an urgent condition that can be life threatening. They made me wait a few days just to get an appointment for an ultrasound! If this was an emergency, my dog would be dead. Please go somewhere else if you love your pet.

Always had a positive experience. Vet actually cares for the pet and doesn't rush through the visit like Irvington pet hospital does. Easy to get appointments and front desk is great

Came in a little late for my appointment but didn't have to wait too long to get my cat, Thor, checked in. The front desk receptionist, Jamie was very polite and had a sweet personality. In about 10-15 mins i was able to meet the Vet, Dr. Salwan, who knew how to carefully handle my rather cranky and defensive cat at the time. He informed me what treatments my cat will be undergoing (de-worming and anal gland treatments) and had me wait for about 30 minutes in the lobby. Overall, staff was very friendly despite my vet tech repeatedly calling my cat a "She" when he is a male.. It is also more financially affordable than other clinics I have been to. Only reason why I took a star down was because the facility does not look as tidy as a hospital should be (weighing scale looked nasty before Jamie cleaned it). Also, the information I had to give felt a little redundant since I had to tell three different people the same exact issues I was having with my cat, which I felt was a bit of a waste of time..
Came here to have my pups nails trimmed...2 hours later I'm still waiting. The people are nice but, they're under staffed.

Today, I witnessed a miracle. After going through a vet that charged thousands of dollars only to make Teddy, our foster dog, worse; after so many no-kill foster organizations & shelters literally rejecting Teddy because of his poor condition, my friend Krissy & I were about ready to sign off the euthanasia papers for him because he was just in so much pain & we didn't know what else to do. The very LAST animal hospital we went to happened to be Tricity Veterinary Hospital. The nurses were very kind & sympathetic even without us having an appointment. They not only examined Teddy, but literally welcomed him with open arms. They weren't afraid to touch him and they even worked around the budget of our gofundme page. Thanks to Dr. Sood & the TriCity Veterinary Hospital, Teddy finally had a successful procedure & he is on the road to a second chance at life. Thank you, Tricity Veterinary Hospital so much for your help. Teddy greatly appreciates it more than you'll ever know.

Where to start..ok, well the morning shift receptionists ( Annie and Castle) are great I love them. They are on top of everything with a level mind. The afternoon shift, no names known could care less, are just incompetent. I take my cat there due to a bad problem and the vets are nice. Dr. Bolar is so sweet and takes the time to answer all questions as does Dr. Solomon. There just seems to be two different vets handling one pets file. Things gets misinterpreted, lost, and so on. I had paid for a urine sample for my cat and they were supposed to do and said they did but I found out almost a week later as I called for results I was supposed to get the next day, that they fifnt get the sample and even said they sent me home with a tube to do it at home so the manager didnt charge me again and the morning crew took the urine sample them selves thank God with no problem. Now as for getting test results when told you will get them, good luck! You have to keep calling to bug them for the results. As for time spent there, I have spent 6 hours just waiting for the afternoon shift to let the doc know I was there for hours and was still waiting, he didnt find out until I was ready to walk away and told him myself. He wasn't pleased by his staff. As for appointments, you don't need one its walk in and when you do make one it's not too far out from when you want it. As for price, they are low cost. An x-ray will cost 300 tops, an ultrasound is 650.00, tapeworm shot is 30, regular deworming 14.00, exam is 35.00. Most medications run from 28- 40+ depending on medication. Medication refill is about 20 dollars. So you get the clue right. They are good but when it comes to getting good reception your best bet is to call in the morning and make your appointments in the morning they are very competent and know what they are doing and just keep calling for your test results.

First, the hospital is very dirty. 2nd, we had an appointment at 12:30pm but we still waited for an hour. Their pricing is really cheap compared to other vet hospitals around the vicinity. I'm planning to just get my fur baby's shots here because it is affordable.

Been bringing my dogs here for years. But last 3 years, service has been really bad. Never going back again. Also they charged me 3 times for the same service. Place was really dirty, dog urine on floor that was dry. And much more things wrong. Every time I called that said someone would get back to me n never did. I would not recommend tricity veterinary hospital. Not even if it was an emergency, go elsewhere.
I appreciate the efficiency  of the staff, reminding me of my cat's appointment time and also when she needs shots and other work done.  They were kind and cared about my cat.

Our second annual visit did not go very smoothly.  I tried making an appt. via their online appt. system several times and got no response.  I then tried emailing and also got no response.  Not sure why they even have these things if they don't use them? When we arrived for our appt. they could not find our file. We were then sat waiting for a long time in the exam room for the vet.  The actual vet is very nice but the rest of the staff seem like they could use more training in several areas.  The person who came in with our estimate wasn't really aware of the vaccination packages they offered nor was the girl at the desk.It took nearly 2 hours for a few shots and heartworm test. I want to like this vet because the vet himself seems pretty decent and the prices are fair compared to some places I've used but there is A LOT of room for improvement.
response_content: I just needed an annual exam and shots so nothing major.  For that purpose I was very pleased.  The cost was super reasonable ( about 1/3 of what our former vet VCA charges).  They didn't try to force unnecessary shots or exams or supplies on us (like VCA) . The vet was very nice and spent time discussing our dogs health and asked if we had any questions.  Not sure why there are so many bad reviews but we didn't have any problems.

review_text: Please don't visit this business. The latest reincarnation is now called TriCity Vets.  I've been going to this location for many years now and have seen the steady decline.  It's time to move to a different provider so I won't be back.  Things have gotten so bad now that don't even honor their own coupons!  I spoke to the "manager" Felipe Alvarez but he offered no assistance whatsoever and claimed their prices were already lower than other places.  I escalated it to the next level but there was no response.  It's just ridiculous now.  Long wait times for simple services with few customers.?  Save your sanity and just go someplace else.  Your pet will thank you too.

I brought my dog here to get neutered. Although I read some bad reviews about them... I decided I will give them a try anyways. I had a good experience with them, no troubles at all. Very affordable, cheapest I've seen around plus they have a Groupon Deal! I only give it 4 stars because I felt like the girls in the front could do a better job. When I called to make an appointment, I was put on hold for 10+ mins that I had to hang up and call them back.

First off if i could give 0 stars I would. I took my dog here a couple weeks ago to get a spay. A week before her surgery we had them run test on her to make sure everything was okay. That was 300$ which the money isn't the issue. When we were getting the estimate for the spay and scheduled her appointment they told us we had a choice if she was pregnant we would be able to keep the baby and wait to do surgery or we can abort them. Well I'm my case they called me after they cut her open and killed her babies and told me they didn't know she was pregnant. Which all of this is bullshit. Then they came up with excuses saying her uterus was bad when during her exam it was perfectly fine. We called for a refund due to they're wrongful abortion to my baby and for them messing up her surgery. All they could say was they were so sorry for messing up but they couldn't issue a refund. On top of that 2 days later I had to take my dog into another vet because she had a infection and since they poorly did her stitches they all came out. Please do NOT bring your animal babies here to get tortured or to get a abortion without your knowledge. Go somewhere else and extra money.

this was my 1st time visit there.  when i called, the front desk, the lady was friendly, gave me the price range, what i needed to do a day before the appointment.  since it was my 1st visit, the office visit cost would be free, she said.  we arrived at 815am on 09/05/2020 and paid for the visit (yes, they make you pay before, not after.  this was also my 1st experience that we need to pay up front).  we did not check the list of fees until we got home.  so when we picked up my dog, i asked for a refund.  i couldn't believe the staff can't do any refund or to void the credit card transaction.  i was told only the manager can do that, and the manager works monday - friday.  so if your appointment is on the weekend, pls check the list of fees before you sign the credit card sales slip, otherwise, no one could fix the mistake they make.  Monica said i could give her my CC info with the security code, the manager could refund back to my CC.  i did not feel comfortable to give her the info.  so she promised me the ask the manager to call me on the 8th.  i waited and waited, no call.  so i called 3 times, spoke to monica & julie; they both said will tell the manager to call me back.  it has been 17 days, the manager must be very busy, not even able to call me back for the $35.00 refund.

I called to get pricing on heart worm blood test and prevention medication following the blood tests. I've gone here for years and they are never on time with appointments and to just pick up a refill is never done in a timely manner. When I called I set up an appointment after being told the cost of the blood tests and medication. 
I brought my dog in and while waiting in the waiting room was told that my dog wouldn't be able to have the blood test without an exam by the vet first. At no time was this mentioned when I called for pricing and set up the appointment. Then I remembered last year the same thing happened! 
Between the long wait to be seen and the lack of communication between the staff and customers I will never go back there again!
Anybody know of a good vet that is good and doesn't charge an arm and a leg? 
I don't think the staff really has proper training either! Very frustrating!

I needed my birds wings clipped & toenails cut, this wa the first time I had been here. I had seen the reviews on yelp, but I didn't listen to all those people that gave it one star. Needless to say after almost two hours, the birds came out looking like someone had chewed their wings. Plus they were traumatized! I will never come back to this place! If you love your pet....find another vet!

Great place! i took my dog one day for some problem.  I had no idea bt at the end he came out great, gave me tips which i had no idea of and my dog is super happy even today.  By the way, i recommend being attended by the manager at the front desk Felipe Alvarez. Awesome and very serious about his job.

I am grateful to the entire staff of Tri City (American Animal Hospital) for the expert and loving care administered to my pets Havoc and Pretty Boy over the past 12 years. The staff has always been friendly, courteous and considerate; our pets have received the best of care.  Recently, we lost our dog, Havoc (12 years). Regrettably, because of the nature of his illness in conjunction with his mature age, euthanasia was the last recourse. It was a difficult and heart wrenching decision. During that time, the entire staff was sensitive to our loss, showed compassion, understanding and was very supportive.  I especially want to thank Dr. Sangha for the comfort and consolation given to us during and after our loss. Her presence and words of solace made the loss easier to endure.   The Johnson Family

This vet hospital is a joke. We went in to get our one year old kitten neutered. This is a very typical procedure that the vet has done a million times. When we went in to pick our cat up they tell us she is still in recovery and they will give us a call when she is done. We did not get a call back for a good four hours and when we did get a call the nurse says with no emotion that our cat died but they resuscitated her and she needs to go to a 24 hour pet hospital immediately. When we brought our cat in she was a perfectly normal kitten and now they are saying she has neurological problems. So OBVIOUSLY something happened at this place that fucked our cat up. So if you like your pet alive and healthy DO NOT COME HERE!
